result.markdown:
For most small businesses, I'd recommend **Dropbox Sign or DocuSign**\. However, the best choice depends on how many contracts you send, how many employees need access, and whether you need more than just signatures.

If I were choosing software for a small business in Australia in 2026, these would be my shortlist.

## Best e-signature software compared

![PandaDoc Review: Sign, Seal, Deliver](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/0MUKV24vOJ8Fy84anuzrEeDfSf0kpDjVQFizvzFH_No27CWsxijbo2OMMlOGpvgS85vZB3wg04yrL3uUEA8HfUdyjeWSSz3aH8VUzmHL1gINYfR2lzt9WJR1seELOV2zEpePqA9WPggyXDEs9xtNtG6ptm3fJ7rmZx4q6N4W7fYpmzjZfQx9dTipSbsTdrj3?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Dropbox Sign**

(Best overall for simplicity)

- Easy to use for staff and customers.
- Templates and signature requests.
- Good for everyday business contracts.
- Paid plans offer unlimited signature requests according to current comparisons.

Indicative starting price: US\$15/month

[Official website](https://sign.dropbox.com/)

---

![ドキュサイン / Docusign について](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/xyLq-c8NsrpmXngTDQOlq_nQ-hdoipi8LNAM0PriPm9OXbxzSMFpxHq4mX20RE5oKykXn_ebymihRHVC-xJF-ftlT3muOwPqVZr1LnypOPP6tZDIkDq6IjuWnsebSgjW-6slAQlpUZa-Wz9woFg0UDt6Xeug0D4ulHXJQLs86h2xGptBRDNSUfxqteGaxXDR?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. DocuSign**

(Best for professional contracts)

- Widely recognised by customers and suppliers.
- Strong signing workflows and audit trails.
- Extensive integrations.
- Good for businesses expecting to grow.

Indicative starting price: US\$11/month

[Official website](https://www.docusign.com/)

---

![PandaDoc buys Denario for consolidated document and payment workflow offering](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/nMZU-ikvjF7B27p2YRYbwMFVYldny8ofYsWDYYkqTXdGfrk-N9sresjiQS7_N5GL_z3bC2xtBlASA1wbjcPGc7QwN2zoEnDhBBAByuwL6PooRYdhb5Xb7bjGtsls49X_kKuOQ8O8ieH---UeiE5fGOQC1qFIRtUd6uc0-JR89a70cw5k0Vpz1IUhRMFOX01b?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PandaDoc**

(Best for sales and proposals)

- Create professional quotes and proposals.
- Send contracts for signature.
- Track when customers view and sign documents.
- Useful if you want document creation and signing together.

Indicative starting price: US\$19/user/month (annual billing)

[Official website](https://www.pandadoc.com/)

---

![Best e-signature software | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/wmbNwQd5sZcCQM_y8xDHl0CPe7pgdwCT-krxdtJ31tc_1PKqy7PiBHAl_-Gd913WdMSfKG4tvcbm87CrehlVzyh0S_XfsJoy8bGchL0mjaA3hnz0pBJgnLcUXZcQanS1poRpGWtqsda_EXu0W3Y1sz9Tm8p7il83hsR4mOfYqnnCRPXfp1UL4Ot3PT4uhG1W?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. signNow**

(Best budget option)

- Straightforward electronic signatures.
- Reusable templates.
- Document routing and multiple signers.
- Good value for businesses with several users.

Indicative starting price: US\$8/user/month (annual billing)

[Official website](https://www.signnow.com/)

---

- PDF editing and electronic signatures.
- Useful if your business already uses Adobe.
- Good document management capabilities.

Indicative starting price: US\$16.99/month

## What I'd look for before buying

For a small business, these five features matter most\:

1. **Reusable templates** – so you're not preparing the same contract repeatedly.
2. **Automatic reminders** – chase customers who haven't signed.
3. **Audit trail** – records of who signed, when and document history.
4. **Multiple signers** – allow customers, employees and suppliers to sign.
5. **Australian legal suitability** – check that the provider supports appropriate electronic-signature records and any identity verification or witnessing requirements relevant to your documents.

## My recommendation

- If you mainly send customer contracts: **Dropbox Sign**\.
- If you want a recognised, established signing platform: **DocuSign**\.
- If you send quotes, proposals and contracts: **PandaDoc**\.
- If keeping costs down is your priority: **signNow**\.

## Let me narrow it down for your business

One question: **What type of small business do you operate?**

For example, consulting, construction, trades, professional services, real estate, retail or something else.

I can then recommend the best option based on your actual workflow, including the most cost-effective plan in Australian dollars.

search_results.description: This 2026 guide evaluates leading e-signature platforms for functionality, security, integrations, usability, device compatibility, and legal compliance. Adobe Acrobat Sign is named the best overall option, offering extensive customization, authentication, SAP SuccessFactors integration, mobile and web access, and plans starting at $16.99 monthly with a seven-day trial. DocuSign is recommended for business value, particularly high-volume signing, with templates, tracking, reporting, strong security, broad integrations, and plans from $10 monthly. Dropbox Sign is the budget choice, emphasizing ease of use, cloud-storage compatibility, branding, templates, and AES-256/TLS encryption from $9.99 monthly. eSignatures.io suits freelancers needing pay-as-you-go bulk contracts, charging per contract with discounted credits. SignNow is best for multiple signers, offering collaboration, reusable templates, drag-and-drop fields, and real-time tracking. PandaDoc is recommended for creating sophisticated documents, combining e-signatures with publishing tools, templates, content libraries, CRM integrations, and payment tracking. The guide advises selecting software based on workflow, compliance, security, features, integrations, and budget.
